extracted.name: Homemade pasta
instruction_lines: Mix flour, eggs, oil, salt in mixer until combine (should stay together when you pinch it)
If dry add 1/3 - 1/2 a cup of water a little at a time
Knead dough for 5-8 minutes or until smooth
Place in plastic wrap and put in fridge for 30 mins.
